# Muhammed KV

> Digital marketer and web developer based in Calicut (Kozhikode), Kerala, India. Works across both search and paid advertising as well as building the websites those campaigns point at: SEO, Meta Ads, Google Ads, e-commerce development and brand design.

Independent practitioner, currently at Hello Aura. Serves clients in Kerala and across India, plus e-commerce brands in the UAE and Saudi Arabia. Contact: muhammedkvofficial@gmail.com, +91 99956 09663.

## Services

- Search engine optimisation: technical audits, on-page optimisation, content strategy, local search
- Paid advertising: Meta Ads and Google Ads, set up with conversion tracking before launch
- E-commerce development: Shopify and custom storefronts
- Web development: responsive sites in HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React
- Branding and graphic design: logomarks, wordmarks, social and campaign creative

## Selected work

- [Zedutoys case study](https://www.muhammedkv.com/work/zedutoys/): brand identity and store design for an educational toys retailer, built around age-based browsing so parents shop by what a toy develops rather than by product type
- [Royal Trading Academy case study](https://www.muhammedkv.com/work/royal-trading-academy/): Instagram design and day-to-day page handling for a UAE forex institute, across a 23.5K-follower audience
- [Nadan Camp case study](https://www.muhammedkv.com/work/nadan-camp/): a Kerala travel community's Instagram started from an empty account and grown past 2,000 followers, with the Meta reel campaigns behind it
- Seven live storefronts: Desert Essence and Joker Perfumes (UAE), ZEN (Saudi Arabia), DR.IN, COLE, Elegant Bayt and Sterling. UI/UX, banner design and product design on each.

## Background

- B.Sc. Chemistry, University of Calicut
- Digital marketing training at Fragmtree Campus, Calicut
